captions: Both-condition training, separated into strength and angle components on independent scales. Points are trial values; the line is a Student-t spline mean (nu=5). Shading is model trial SD, not a confidence interval. Red rug marks below the horizontal axis identify excluded outlier=1 trials; they have no error-value coordinate and never enter statistics or fitting.

Student-t model variance: scale squared times nu/(nu-2). Mean and log-scale use separate smooth functions of trial. Training outlier=1 and missing measurements are excluded independently per component; remaining finite training values are included.
Censor panel omitted because no included training observations are censored; panels a and b use the full row.

Both-condition baseline and immediate test, separated into strength and angle components from the same both-condition trials. Each component is compared with its own baseline; neither is pooled with single-condition trials. Full-stage Student-t mean ± model SD (nu=5); n = valid/recorded. No estimate shown when data are insufficient. Error bars are not confidence intervals.

Strength baseline and immediate test under the strength condition. This untrained condition assesses possible transfer. Full-stage Student-t mean ± model SD (nu=5); n = valid/recorded. No estimate shown when data are insufficient. Error bars are not confidence intervals.

Angle baseline and immediate test under the angle condition. This untrained condition assesses possible transfer. Full-stage Student-t mean ± model SD (nu=5); n = valid/recorded. No estimate shown when data are insufficient. Error bars are not confidence intervals.
